title: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence

clauses.title: Proportionality and do no harm
clauses.text: AI systems shall do no harm to humans or the environment; uses shall be proportionate to the legitimate aim pursued.
clauses.rationale: already covered by ADT framework AI_PROTOCOL.md tier-2 governance

clauses.title: Safety and security
clauses.text: Unwanted harms and vulnerabilities of AI systems shall be avoided, addressed and prevented throughout their life cycle.

clauses.title: Fairness and non-discrimination
clauses.text: AI actors shall promote social justice, fairness and non-discrimination of any kind in compliance with international law.

clauses.title: Sustainability
clauses.text: AI technologies shall be assessed against their impact on environmental, social, economic and cultural sustainability.

clauses.title: Right to privacy and data protection
clauses.text: Privacy shall be respected, protected and promoted throughout the AI system life cycle; adequate data protection frameworks shall be established.

clauses.title: Human oversight and determination
clauses.text: Member States shall ensure that ethical and legal responsibility for AI-system decisions is ultimately attributable to natural or legal persons.

clauses.title: Transparency and explainability
clauses.text: Transparency and explainability of AI systems shall be ensured in proportion to the context and impact of AI systems.

clauses.title: Responsibility and accountability
clauses.text: Mechanisms shall be put in place to ensure responsibility and accountability for AI systems and their impacts.
